description: Source code for the SQL store implementation of Recap and RecapChannel management in Mattermost, including database interactions, JSON marshaling/unmarshaling, and CRUD operations.

classes.name: SqlRecapStore
classes.description: Implements the store.RecapStore interface for managing recaps and recap channels in SQL database.

methods.name: newSqlRecapStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlRecapStore, initializes SQL queries for recaps and recap channels.

methods.name: recapToMap
methods.description: Converts a Recap model to a map for database insertion.

methods.name: recapChannelToMap
methods.description: Converts a RecapChannel model to a map, marshaling certain fields to JSON strings.

methods.name: SaveRecap
methods.description: Saves a Recap to the database.

methods.name: GetRecapsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves paginated recaps for a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateRecapStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Recap.

methods.name: MarkRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a Recap as read by setting ReadAt timestamp.

methods.name: DeleteRecapChannels
methods.description: Deletes all RecapChannels associated with a Recap.

methods.name: SaveRecapChannel
methods.description: Saves a RecapChannel to the database.

methods.name: GetRecapChannelsByRecapId
methods.description: Retrieves all RecapChannels for a given Recap ID, unmarshaling JSON fields.
